title: Staggered hero dashboard entry choreography
blurb: Composites four live HTML dashboard modules inside one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas with staggered entry and exit choreography across blur-scale rise, 3D origami unfold, elastic wave and directional smear.
question: Can one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas choreograph staggered entry and exit transitions across four live drawable HTML dashboard modules with blur-scale, 3D origami unfold, elastic wave and directional smear shaders while locking hit testing 1:1 on settle?
result: Measured in headless Chrome 160.0.8188.0 canary (2026-11-27, 412x915 at 2.625 DPR and 1024x900 at 1 DPR): 6/6 live checks pass (1.19 MP, 9.51 MB on one ElementGL context, 0 lost contexts, 0 open snapshots), elementsFromPoint() hits controls across all 4 modules, and plain HTML fallback activates when disabled. Chrome 159 on Android and npm run check:jank stay not verified.
